A culture's mass changes at a rate of $\dfrac{dM}{dt}=8t-6$ grams per hour.
The mass is $20$ grams when $t=1$.
Find an equation for $M$ in terms of $t$.

questions.question_text:
A curve passes through $(1,4)$ and has gradient $\dfrac{dy}{dx}=\dfrac{3}{\sqrt{x}}-2x$ for $x>0$.
Find the equation of the curve.

questions.question_text:
A curve passes through the point $(2,3)$.
At every point on the curve $\dfrac{dy}{dx}=6x^2$.
What is the equation of the curve?
